spanish: Y veía todo el pueblo la columna de la nube parada abertura de la tienda, y se levantaba todo el pueblo, y se postraban, varón abertura de su tienda.
readerNote: hold: clause role — "abertura de la tienda" and "abertura de su tienda" are only juxtaposed after the standing participle and after "varón"; which noun governs that locative role (what stands there, where each man is) is not fixed by the draft, so the Spanish is left unchanged.
